[[2007 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament|2007 NCAA Tournament]] }} '''Taurean Green''' is a point guard who played on the [[2007]] [[University of Florida]] Gators Men's [[Basketball]] Team, which won the [[2006 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament]] on [[April 3]], [[2006]] and the [[2007 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament]] on [[April 2]], [[2007]], as well as the 2006 SEC Tournament. Taurean Green has also passed the prestigious 1,000 point benchmark in his career at Florida, racking up over 1,000 points in just 3 seasons, one of which he did not play much. Other teammates to pass this benchmark include [[Joakim Noah]] (MVP of the 2006 Men's Division I Basketball Tournament), [[Corey Brewer]], fellow starter, and [[Al Horford]], who was the latest of the 4 to pass it doing so in the March 4th game against Kentucky. These four are also roommates. In 2007, it's been much the same, as the Gators won the 2007 SEC Tournament. Taurean Green is the son of former [[NBA]] player [[Sidney Green (basketball)|Sidney Green]]. He is one of the nation's best conditioned point guards, averaging close to 35 minutes per game. Green has declared himself eligible for the [[2007 NBA Draft]], and so will likely not be returning for a senior season. {{DEFAULTSORT:Green, Taurean}} [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:American basketball players]] [[Category:African American basketball players]] [[Category:Florida Gators men's basketball players]] [[Category:Point guards]] {{US-hoops-bio-stub}}
